J.P. Morgan Asset Management today announced its tokenized money market fund suite, My OnChain Net Yield Fund ("MONY") and JPMorgan OnChain Liquidityâ Token Money Market Fund ("JLTXX"), is now available on the Solana blockchain to qualified U.S. investors, strengthening the firm's tokenized capabilities. This expansion broadens access for clients and supports the continued growth of J.P. Morgan Asset Management's tokenized cash management platform.
MONY is a 506(c) private placement fund that provides qualified investors the opportunity to earn U.S. dollar yields. At the time of its launch in December 2025, J.P. Morgan was the largest global systemically important bank to launch a tokenized money market fund on a public blockchain. JLTXX is a U.S. registered government money market fund designed to invest in a manner to support stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act.
Investors can access MONY and JLTXX through Morgan MoneyÂ®, J.P. Morgan Asset Management's open-architecture trading and analytics platform for liquidity management. Through a single platform, qualified investors can subscribe and redeem into J.P. Morgan Asset Management's tokenized funds, receiving token balances at their blockchain addresses. This process supports a consistent experience as clients continue to expand tokenized activity across networks and multi-chain adoption accelerates.
"Our clients operate across more than one network, and their liquidity should too," said Paul Przybylski, Global Head of Product, Digital & Tokenized Assets, J.P. Morgan Asset Management . "Bringing JLTXX and MONY to Solana gives stablecoin issuers and institutional investors access to the same funds, across the on-chain networks where they operate. This launch builds on our position as one of the leaders in tokenized liquidity and underscores our commitment to scaling tokenized cash management through multi-chain channels."
For more information, please visit our dedicated website . The MONY blockchain token address on Solana is EToDtBM2knZ8N1BHyUq2Riq5ngWTcoD3k6qpsgf7CKYY and the JLTXX blockchain token address on Solana is J4cTuCH6frt4AnEmKfMS2k8hsUf7K94PV62sjUJno8Cz.

Information about JPMorgan Chase & Co. is available at www.jpmorganchase.com .

A multi-currency, open architecture trading and risk management system, the platform is designed to deliver a seamless customer experience, centered on operational efficiency, end-to-end system integration, and effective controls to allow customers to invest when, where and how they want â securely. This platform is designed for clients, by clients â embedding their needs and priorities into its core capabilities. Additional information is available at https://www.morganmoney.io/ .

MONY -- FOR QUALIFIED INVESTORS ONLY. MONY is intended for investors who qualify to invest in private placement funds. Generally, they would include investors who are "Qualified Purchasers" as described in the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended, and "Accredited Investors" as defined in the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.
Blockchain technology is new and evolving, and its use by the Fund carries risks, including transaction delays or errors, security breaches, regulatory changes, fluctuating fees, and network splits that create alternative blockchains. Differences from traditional mutual funds may also affect how issues are addressed. Investors should safeguard their private keys, and future regulation may affect blockchain adoption.
You could lose money by investing in the Funds. Although the Funds seek to preserve the value of your investment at $1.00 per share, they cannot guarantee they will do so. An investment in the Funds are not a bank account and is not insured or guaranteed by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or any other government agency. The Funds' sponsor is not required to reimburse the Funds for losses, and you should not expect that the sponsor will provide financial support to the Funds at any time, including during periods of market stress.
